listed_supplements.title: Video S1. An example of social approach behavior of an observer rat following laser irradiation of the forepaw of a demonstrator rat, related to Figure 2 The text “Laser” appears in the left corner when the demonstrator’s forepaw was hit at time 617.8271s. The demonstrator lifted and licked its forepaw and the observer then shifted its body and head position, pushed its nose against a hole in the partition. The activity of a simultaneously recorded InC unit is shown in the bottom panel.

Video S2.An example of rat helping behavior and a mirror neuron in InC activated before door opening, related to Figure 7 Superimposed waveforms (left panel) and PC1-PC2 plot (right panel) were shown in the opening scene. A mirror neuron in InC activa. It shows no change before door opening at t = 96 in the toy trial.
